description: Climate Change Atlas for Tree and Bird Species is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by U.S. Forest Service (USFS). These two atlases document the current and projected future distribution of tree species and bird species in the eastern United States. Changes in temperature and precipitation will affect the future distribution of tree species, and changes in the distribution of trees will have an effect on many species of birds. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
